theme, display scale, high contrast and reduced-motion preferences
keyboard shortcuts and context-menu workspace access

real file-system mounts and file portals

acceptance.preview_test: node syntax check plus desktop contract regression tests
acceptance.native_acceptance: requires implementation, session-manager wiring, packaged artifacts and runtime evidence on each supported target
acceptance.policy: A browser preview or feature inventory must never be reported as a native desktop implementation.

evidence_required: native compositor binary built for target
DRM/KMS device initialization and fallback logs
hardware or software rendering smoke test

native_acceptance_gates.subsystem: Multi-monitor, HDR, input and color management
evidence_required: input device discovery and event delivery
color/HDR capability detection with safe fallback
kernel-owned PID 1 or supported native init
per-user service supervision and failure recovery
mounted filesystem operations from target userspace

native_acceptance_gates.subsystem: Networking, Bluetooth, audio, power, sleep and notifications
Signed packages, sandboxing and secure credentials
Accessibility APIs, IME, localization and compositor recovery
Production ISO desktop launch and readiness
evidence_required: target-specific production init payload in generated ISO
same nonzero kernel PID in target readiness marker
six separate runs using unchanged verifier
matching kernel-owned nonzero PID for each case

native_acceptance_gates.subsystem: Aurora, installer, Recovery and AP-backed SMP
evidence_required: installer completes disk workflow and reboots into installed system
Recovery performs a real repair/diagnostic operation
multiple APs online with measured concurrent execution

native_acceptance_gates.subsystem: Cross-platform application catalog, packaging and desktop integration
evidence_required: application catalog has unique IDs, upstream provenance, platform scope and reviewed license/third-party notices
native package build and dependency-resolution result for each app claimed as supported
install, launch, open-file/MIME association, quit, update and rollback tests on each supported target
permission/sandbox and signature-verification tests for packaged apps
media codec, graphics acceleration, input/controller and accessibility capability tests where applicable
no app is advertised as installed or runnable unless the target artifact and runtime test exist

rules: A browser preview is not a native desktop implementation.
A GTK host shell is not a Koronos-native compositor or session manager.
A successful build or kernel boot is not production userspace readiness.
Probe ELFs, synthetic markers, weakened verifiers and host OS services cannot substitute for the actual production path.
Do not publish a production release until every required native acceptance gate has retained passing evidence.
